name: cli-delivery-retry-restart
description: M21 S3 (X-rider W1): one inbound turn whose reply hits a scripted transport failure on its first delivery attempt, leaving persisted retry state (tries=1 + a wall-clock not_before window) on the messages_out row. The registered test then kills and recreates the DeliveryService across the remaining attempts to pin restart-resume and exactly-once dead-lettering.
